events.evidence: A bomb detonates on a crowded bus north of Peshawar, Pakistan, killing 19 government employees and injuring 45

Iranian Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif meets with U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry during P5+1 and Iran talks, the highest-level direct contact between the United States and Iran in six years
Police fire teargas to disperse thousands of demonstrators demanding the resignation of President Omar Hassan al-Bashir with the death toll of this week's unrest believed to have reached 50

label.note: Attacks and protests mixed with U.S.-Iran diplomatic contact; risk appetite broadly stable.
